Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVI OF 1997
ORDINANCE XLVI OF 1997
PAKISTAN RANGERS (AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Pakistan Range; s Ordinance, 1959
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, An March, 1997]
No.F.2(1)/97‑Pub., dated 7‑3‑1997.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President on the 2nd March, 1997 is hereby
published for general information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959), for
the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This
Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Rangers (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 3, W.P. Ordinance XIV of 1959

2. Amendment of section 3, W.P.
Ordinance XIV of 1959.‑‑In the Pakistan Rangers Ordinance, 1959 (XIV of 1959),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 3, in subsection (4),
for the words "Force shall be administered by the Director‑General"
the words and commas "Federal Government shall, for administration of the
Force, appoint Director‑General" shall be substituted.

XIV of 1959.‑‑‑In
the said Ordinance, in section 4,‑‑‑
(a) for subsection (1) following
shall be substituted, namely:‑‑‑
"(1) The Federal Government may
appoint as many Directors‑General and Deputy Directors‑General of
the Force as it may consider necessary and determine their headquarters, places
of duties and area of jurisdiction."; and
(b) subsection (2) shall be omitted.

Repeal
